6 Independent AI Red Lines for UKSA

Responsible Space Operations & Debris Mitigation

  • AI must adhere to the UK Space Agency's Code of Conduct for Outer Space Activities.
  • Compliance with UN Outer Space Treaty and IADC guidelines for space debris mitigation.
  • No autonomous kinetic actions in orbit without human-in-the-loop decision and explicit authorization.

Data Privacy & Security in Space

  • Strict adherence to UK data protection laws for any personal data collected via Earth observation satellites.
  • Secure handling of sensitive national security and commercial space data.
  • Compliance with NCSC guidelines for critical national infrastructure in space.

Non-Proliferation & Dual-Use Technologies

  • AI applications must be rigorously screened to prevent proliferation of WMD or misuse of dual-use technologies.
  • Adherence to the Wassenaar Arrangement and other international export control regimes.
  • Transparency in AI capabilities to avoid misinterpretation of intent in orbit.

International Collaboration & Peacefulness

  • AI systems must support, not hinder, the peaceful use of outer space and international cooperation.
  • Compliance with UK's commitments under the European Space Agency (ESA) framework.
  • Avoidance of any AI deployment that could lead to escalation or conflict in space.

Ethical AI & Accountability in Space

  • Clear ethical guidelines for AI in autonomous space systems, including potential for unintended consequences.
  • Defined accountability structures for AI failures or adverse events in space operations.
  • Independent oversight and review for all high-risk AI applications in space.

Cybersecurity & Supply Chain Integrity

  • Robust cybersecurity for AI systems in space, protecting against jamming, spoofing, and unauthorized access.
  • Ensuring integrity of the AI supply chain for critical space components, guarding against foreign interference.
  • Compliance with relevant UK security standards for national space infrastructure.

DEFONEOS 5-Step Engagement Model for UKSA

  1. Space Mission Requirements Analysis

    Detailed assessment of UKSA's strategic objectives, current space assets, and data streams to identify high-impact areas for independent AI integration in mission planning and execution.

  2. AI Governance & Compliance for Space

    Co-development of an AI governance framework tailored to the unique regulatory and ethical challenges of space (e.g., orbital debris, dual-use tech), ensuring international treaty compliance.

  3. Pilot Deployment & Validation in Space Domain

    Phased deployment of DEFONEOS MCPs in simulated or low-risk space scenarios, rigorous testing, and validation against mission critical performance and safety metrics.

  4. Scalable Integration & Operationalization

    Seamless integration of validated AI solutions into UKSA's ground segment and space-based platforms, with comprehensive training and support for mission controllers and analysts.

  5. Continuous Assurance & Ethical Oversight for Space AI

    Ongoing monitoring, performance optimization, and independent ethical auditing to ensure long-term value, safety, and international trust in AI systems deployed in space.
